161:         displayName: actor.displayName,
162:         modelDisplayName,
163:         role,
164:         modelId,
165:         providerId,
166:         teamId,
167:         teamName,
168:         membership: membership ?? 'joined',
169:         presence: 'offline', // presence resolved independently
170:         workState: workState ?? 'available',
171:         currentAssignment: assignment,
172:         joinedAt: record.timestamp,
173:         lastActivityAt: record.timestamp,
174:       });
175:     }
176:   }
177: 
178:   private deriveMembership(record: ActivityRecord): MembershipState | undefined {
179:     if (record.type === 'human.message' && record.actor.type === 'human') {
180:       return 'joined';
181:     }
182:     if (record.type.startsWith('agent.')) {
183:       return 'joined';
184:     }
185:     return undefined;
186:   }
187: 
188:   private deriveWorkState(record: ActivityRecord): WorkState | undefined {
189:     switch (record.type) {
190:       case 'task.started':
191:       case 'agent.started':
192:         return 'working';
193:       case 'task.runnable':
194:         return record.actor.type === 'agent' ? 'available' : undefined;
195:       case 'task.completed':
196:       case 'agent.completed':
197:         return 'available';
198:       case 'task.failed':
199:       case 'agent.failed':
200:         return 'attention-required';
201:       case 'agent.waiting':
202:         return 'waiting';
203:       case 'workflow.failed':
204:         return record.actor.type === 'agent' ? 'blocked' : undefined;
205:       default:
206:         return undefined;
207:     }
208:   }
209: 
210:   private deriveAssignment(record: ActivityRecord): ParticipantProjection['currentAssignment'] | undefined {
211:     if (record.type === 'task.started' && record.taskId && record.workflowRunId) {
212:       return {
213:         workflowRunId: record.workflowRunId,
214:         taskId: record.taskId,
215:         taskTitle: record.payload.message,
216:       };
217:     }
218:     return undefined;
219:   }
220: 
221:   // ─── Stream Management ────────────────────────────────────
222: 
223:   private recordToStreamItem(record: ActivityRecord): StreamItem {
224:     const kind = this.classifyKind(record);
225:     const importance = this.classifyImportance(record, kind);
226:     const activityIdStr = String(record.activityId);
227: 
228:     const base: StreamItem = {
229:       streamItemId: `si-${activityIdStr}`,
230:       activityId: activityIdStr,
231:       sequenceNumber: record.sequenceNumber,
232:       kind,
233:       importance,
234:       actor: record.actor,
235:       content: record.payload.message ?? `${record.type}`,
236:       timestamp: record.timestamp,
237:       workflowRunId: record.workflowRunId,
238:       executionId: record.executionId,
239:       taskId: record.taskId,
240:     };
241: 
242:     // Carry interaction presentation data for kind === 'interaction'
243:     if (kind === 'interaction' && record.payload.data) {
244:       const data = record.payload.data as Record<string, unknown>;
245:       const interactionId = typeof data.interactionId === 'string' ? data.interactionId : undefined;
246:       if (interactionId) {
247:         const lifecycle = record.type === 'interaction.responded' ? ('responded' as const) : ('presented' as const);
248:         const choices = Array.isArray(data.choices)
249:           ? (data.choices as readonly { choiceId: string; label: string; description?: string }[])
250:           : undefined;
251:         const selectedChoiceId = typeof data.selectedChoiceId === 'string' ? data.selectedChoiceId : undefined;
252:         const respondingParticipantId = lifecycle === 'responded' ? record.actor.id : undefined;
253:         const respondingParticipantName = lifecycle === 'responded' ? record.actor.displayName : undefined;
254: 
255:         return {
256:           ...base,
257:           interaction: {
258:             interactionId,
259:             lifecycle,
260:             ...(choices ? { choices } : {}),
261:             ...(selectedChoiceId ? { selectedChoiceId } : {}),
262:             ...(respondingParticipantId ? { respondingParticipantId } : {}),
263:             ...(respondingParticipantName ? { respondingParticipantName } : {}),
264:           },
265:         };
266:       }
267:     }
268: 
269:     return base;
270:   }
271: 
272:   private classifyKind(record: ActivityRecord): StreamItemKind {
273:     switch (record.type) {
274:       case 'human.message':
275:         return 'conversation';
276:       case 'workflow.started':
277:       case 'workflow.completed':
278:       case 'task.started':
279:       case 'task.completed':
280:       case 'agent.assigned':
281:       case 'agent.completed':
282:         return 'activity';
283:       case 'agent.progress':
284:         return 'progress';
285:       case 'tool.called':
286:         return 'tool-call';
287:       case 'tool.succeeded':
288:       case 'tool.failed':
289:         return 'tool-result';
290:       case 'task.runnable':
291:         return 'log';
292:       case 'task.failed':
293:       case 'agent.failed':
294:       case 'workflow.failed':
295:         return 'diagnostic';
296:       case 'system.event':
297:         return record.payload.data ? 'evidence' : 'telemetry';
298:       case 'interaction.presented':
299:       case 'interaction.responded':
300:         return 'interaction';
301:       default:
302:         return 'log';
303:     }
304:   }
305: 
306:   private classifyImportance(record: ActivityRecord, kind: StreamItemKind): StreamImportance {
307:     // Human messages are always primary
308:     if (record.type === 'human.message') return 'primary';
309: 
310:     // Workflow lifecycle is primary
311:     if (record.type === 'workflow.started' || record.type === 'workflow.completed') return 'primary';
312:     if (record.type === 'workflow.failed') return 'primary';
313: 
314:     // Task lifecycle is secondary
315:     if (record.type === 'task.started' || record.type === 'task.completed') return 'secondary';
316:     if (record.type === 'task.failed') return 'secondary';
317: 
318:     // Agent assigned/completed is secondary
319:     if (record.type === 'agent.assigned' || record.type === 'agent.completed') return 'secondary';
320: 
321:     // Tool operations are secondary (visible, not primary)
322:     if (record.type === 'tool.called' || record.type === 'tool.succeeded' || record.type === 'tool.failed')
323:       return 'secondary';
324: 
325:     // Interaction: presented is primary (decision needed), responded is secondary
326:     if (record.type === 'interaction.presented') return 'primary';
327:     if (record.type === 'interaction.responded') return 'secondary';
328: 
329:     // Progress, logs, telemetry are muted
330:     if (kind === 'progress' || kind === 'log' || kind === 'telemetry') return 'muted';
331: 
332:     // Default to secondary
333:     return 'secondary';
334:   }
335: 
336:   private aggregateMutedItems(items: StreamItem[]): StreamItem[] {
337:     const result: StreamItem[] = [];
338:     let mutedBuffer: StreamItem[] = [];
339: 
340:     for (const item of items) {
341:       if (item.importance === 'muted') {
342:         mutedBuffer.push(item);
343:         if (mutedBuffer.length >= MUTING_THRESHOLD) {
344:           result.push(this.coalesceMuted(mutedBuffer));
345:           mutedBuffer = [];
346:         }
347:       } else {
348:         if (mutedBuffer.length > 0) {
349:           result.push(this.coalesceMuted(mutedBuffer));
350:           mutedBuffer = [];
351:         }
352:         result.push(item);
353:       }
354:     }
355: 
356:     // Flush remaining muted items
357:     if (mutedBuffer.length > 0) {
358:       result.push(this.coalesceMuted(mutedBuffer));
359:     }
360: 
361:     return result;
362:   }
363: 
364:   private coalesceMuted(items: StreamItem[]): StreamItem {
365:     if (items.length === 1) return items[0];
366: 
367:     const kindCounts = new Map<StreamItemKind, number>();
368:     for (const item of items) {
369:       kindCounts.set(item.kind, (kindCounts.get(item.kind) ?? 0) + 1);
370:     }
371: 
372:     const dominantKind = [...kindCounts.entries()].sort((a, b) => b[1] - a[1])[0][0];
373:     const totalLogs = items.filter((i) => i.kind === 'log').length;
374:     const totalTools = items.filter((i) => i.kind === 'progress').length;
375:     const warnings = items.filter((i) => i.kind === 'diagnostic').length;
376: 
377:     const parts: string[] = [];
378:     if (totalLogs > 0) parts.push(`${totalLogs} logs`);
379:     if (totalTools > 0) parts.push(`${totalTools} tools`);
380:     if (warnings > 0) parts.push(`${warnings} warning${warnings > 1 ? 's' : ''}`);
381: 
382:     return {
383:       streamItemId: `si-agg-${items[0].sequenceNumber}-${items[items.length - 1].sequenceNumber}`,
384:       activityId: items[0].activityId,
385:       sequenceNumber: items[0].sequenceNumber,
386:       kind: dominantKind,
387:       importance: 'muted',
388:       actor: items[0].actor,
389:       content: `${items.length} activities`,
390:       timestamp: items[items.length - 1].timestamp,
391:       aggregated: {
392:         count: items.length,
393:         kind: dominantKind,
394:         summary: parts.join(' · ') || `${items.length} items`,
395:         referencedActivityIds: items.map((i) => i.activityId),
396:         sequenceRange: {
397:           first: items[0].sequenceNumber,
398:           last: items[items.length - 1].sequenceNumber,
399:         },
400:       },
401:     };
402:   }

404:   // ─── Workflow Summary ─────────────────────────────────────
405: 
406:   private updateWorkflowSummary(record: ActivityRecord): void {
407:     if (!record.workflowRunId) return;
408: 
409:     const existing = this.workflowSummaries.get(record.workflowRunId);
410: 
411:     const status = this.deriveWorkflowStatus(record);
412:     const taskUpdate = this.deriveTaskUpdate(record);
413: 
414:     if (existing) {
415:       this.workflowSummaries.set(record.workflowRunId, {
416:         ...existing,
417:         status: status ?? existing.status,
418:         taskCount: taskUpdate?.taskCount ?? existing.taskCount,
419:         completedTasks: taskUpdate?.completedTasks ?? existing.completedTasks,
420:         failedTasks: taskUpdate?.failedTasks ?? existing.failedTasks,
421:         currentTask: taskUpdate?.currentTask ?? existing.currentTask,
422:         lastActivityAt: record.timestamp,
423:       });
424:     } else {
425:       this.workflowSummaries.set(record.workflowRunId, {
426:         workflowRunId: record.workflowRunId,
427:         executionId: record.executionId,
428:         status: status ?? 'running',
429:         taskCount: taskUpdate?.taskCount ?? 0,
430:         completedTasks: taskUpdate?.completedTasks ?? 0,
431:         failedTasks: taskUpdate?.failedTasks ?? 0,
432:         currentTask: taskUpdate?.currentTask,
433:         startedAt: record.timestamp,
434:         lastActivityAt: record.timestamp,
435:       });
436:     }
437:   }
438: 
439:   private deriveWorkflowStatus(record: ActivityRecord): WorkflowSummary['status'] | undefined {
440:     switch (record.type) {
441:       case 'workflow.started':
442:         return 'running';
443:       case 'workflow.completed':
444:         return 'completed';
445:       case 'workflow.failed':
446:         return 'failed';
447:       case 'workflow.cancelled':

449:       default:

451:     }
452:   }

454:   private deriveTaskUpdate(record: ActivityRecord): Partial<WorkflowSummary> | undefined {
455:     switch (record.type) {
456:       case 'task.started':
457:         return { currentTask: record.taskId };
458:       case 'task.completed':
459:         return { completedTasks: 1, currentTask: undefined };
460:       case 'task.failed':
461:         return { failedTasks: 1 };
462:       case 'task.runnable':
463:         return { taskCount: 1 };
464:       default:
465:         return undefined;
466:     }
467:   }

469:   private getLatestWorkflowSummary(): WorkflowSummary | undefined {
470:     const summaries = [...this.workflowSummaries.values()];
471:     if (summaries.length === 0) return undefined;
472:     return summaries.reduce((latest, s) => (s.lastActivityAt > latest.lastActivityAt ? s : latest));
473:   }

475:   // ─── Attention ────────────────────────────────────────────
476: 
477:   private generateAttention(record: ActivityRecord): void {
478:     const attention = this.deriveAttention(record);
479:     if (attention) {
480:       // Deduplicate: don't create duplicate attention for same task+reason
481:       // Skip dedup when taskId is undefined (interaction attention uses interactionId instead)
482:       const existing =
483:         attention.taskId !== undefined
484:           ? this.attention.find(
485:               (a) => a.taskId === attention.taskId && a.reason === attention.reason && !a.acknowledged,
486:             )
487:           : undefined;
488:       if (!existing) {
489:         this.attention.push(attention);
490:       } else {
491:         // Always update to reflect latest failure details
492:         const idx = this.attention.indexOf(existing);
493:         this.attention[idx] = attention;
494:       }
495:     }
496: 
497:     // Deduplicate interaction attention: at most one unacknowledged per interactionId
498:     if (attention?.interactionId) {
499:       const dup = this.attention.find(
500:         (a) => a.interactionId === attention.interactionId && a.reason === attention.reason && !a.acknowledged,
501:       );
502:       if (dup && dup !== attention) {
503:         // Already have an unacknowledged attention for this interaction — remove the older one
504:         const idx = this.attention.indexOf(dup);
505:         this.attention.splice(idx, 1);
506:       }
507:     }
508: 
509:     // Auto-resolve attention when task completes
510:     if (record.type === 'task.completed' && record.taskId) {
511:       const toResolve = this.attention.find((a) => a.taskId === record.taskId && !a.acknowledged);
512:       if (toResolve) {
513:         const idx = this.attention.indexOf(toResolve);
514:         this.attention[idx] = { ...toResolve, acknowledged: true };
515:       }
516:     }
517: 
518:     // Auto-resolve interaction attention when interaction is responded
519:     if (record.type === 'interaction.responded') {
520:       const data = record.payload.data as Record<string, unknown> | undefined;
521:       const interactionId = typeof data?.interactionId === 'string' ? data.interactionId : undefined;
522:       if (interactionId) {
523:         const toResolve = this.attention.find((a) => a.interactionId === interactionId && !a.acknowledged);
524:         if (toResolve) {
525:           const idx = this.attention.indexOf(toResolve);
526:           this.attention[idx] = { ...toResolve, acknowledged: true };
527:         }
528:       }
529:     }
530:   }

540:           actor: record.actor,
541:           workflowRunId: record.workflowRunId,

119:   const origRun = db.run.bind(db);

438: /**
439:  * Compose Activity Room participants from two authoritative sources:
440:  *
441:  * 1. M10 projection (lifecycle-derived): runtime presence, work state, current assignment
442:  * 2. Agent/Team authority (config-driven): agent identity, team membership, AI binding
443:  *
444:  * Agent/Team authority answers "who belongs in the room/team."
445:  * M10/lifecycle state answers "what is happening to/with that participant."
446:  *
447:  * Activity Room does NOT define teams, roles, or model bindings.
448:  * It consumes them from upstream AgentStorage/AgentTeam authorities.
449:  */
450: async function composeParticipants(
451:   ctx: WorkspaceContext,
452:   room: M11ARoomState,
453: ): Promise<readonly ParticipantProjection[]> {
454:   // 1. Get lifecycle-derived participants from M10 projection
455:   if (Date.now() - room.lastProjectionAt > MAX_CURSOR_AGE_MS) {
456:     const records = await room.store.rebuild();
457:     room.lastProjection = room.runtime.rebuild(records);
458:     room.lastProjectionAt = Date.now();
459:   }
460:   const lifecycleParticipants = room.lastProjection?.participants ?? [];
461: 
462:   // Build lookup: participantId → lifecycle participant
463:   const lifecycleById = new Map<string, ParticipantProjection>();
464:   for (const p of lifecycleParticipants) {
465:     lifecycleById.set(p.participantId, p);
466:   }
467: 
468:   // 2. Get agent/team authority from AgentStorage
469:   const allAgents = await ctx.agents.listAgents();
470:   const allTeams = await ctx.agents.listTeams();
471: 
472:   // Build team membership map: agentId → { teamId, teamName }
473:   const teamByAgentId = new Map<string, { teamId: string; teamName: string }>();
474:   for (const team of allTeams) {
475:     // team.memberIds contains agent IDs
476:     for (const agentId of team.memberIds) {
477:       if (!teamByAgentId.has(agentId)) {
478:         teamByAgentId.set(agentId, { teamId: team.id, teamName: team.name });
479:       }
480:     }
481:     // Also check agent-side back-reference (teamId on agent definition)
482:     for (const agent of allAgents) {
483:       if (agent.teamId === team.id && !teamByAgentId.has(agent.id)) {
484:         teamByAgentId.set(agent.id, { teamId: team.id, teamName: team.name });
485:       }
486:     }
487:   }
488: 
489:   // 3. Build composed participant list
490:   const composed: ParticipantProjection[] = [];
491:   const seenIds = new Set<string>();
492: 
493:   // 3a. Add all configured agents from AgentStorage
494:   for (const agent of allAgents) {
495:     const participantId = `agent-${agent.id}`;
496:     const teamMembership = teamByAgentId.get(agent.id);
497:     const lifecycle = lifecycleById.get(participantId);
498: 
499:     if (lifecycle) {
500:       // Agent has lifecycle history — enrich with team/agent authority metadata
501:       composed.push({
502:         ...lifecycle,
503:         // Canonical identity: agent.name is the human-readable name (e.g. "Developer")
504:         // agent.id is the stable key (e.g. "agent-developer") — not suitable for display
505:         displayName: agent.name || agent.id,
506:         modelDisplayName: agent.model || undefined,
507:         role: agent.role || lifecycle.role,
508:         modelId: agent.model || lifecycle.modelId,
509:         providerId: agent.provider || lifecycle.providerId,
510:         // Team membership from AgentTeam authority
511:         teamId: teamMembership?.teamId ?? lifecycle.teamId,
512:         teamName: teamMembership?.teamName ?? lifecycle.teamName,
513:       });
514:     } else {
515:       // Agent configured but has no lifecycle history — render with idle state
516:       composed.push({
517:         participantId,
518:         type: 'agent' as const,
519:         displayName: agent.name || agent.id,
520:         modelDisplayName: agent.model || undefined,
521:         role: agent.role || undefined,
522:         modelId: agent.model || undefined,
523:         providerId: agent.provider || undefined,
524:         teamId: teamMembership?.teamId,
525:         teamName: teamMembership?.teamName,
526:         membership: 'joined' as const,
527:         presence: 'offline' as const,
528:         workState: 'available' as const,
529:         joinedAt: agent.createdAt,
530:         lastActivityAt: agent.createdAt,
531:       });
532:     }
533:     seenIds.add(participantId);
534:   }
535: 
536:   // 3b. Add human participants from lifecycle projection (not in AgentStorage)
537:   for (const p of lifecycleParticipants) {
538:     if (p.type === 'human' && !seenIds.has(p.participantId)) {
539:       composed.push(p);
540:       seenIds.add(p.participantId);
541:     }
542:   }

544:   return composed;

581:     json(res, 200, {

584:       stream: projection.stream.map(sanitizeStreamItem).slice(0, 50), // Bounded preview
585:       workflowSummary: projection.workflowSummary ? sanitizeWorkflowSummary(projection.workflowSummary) : null,

589:       cursor: projection.room.cursor,
590:     });
591:     // Track snapshot latency
592:     const snapElapsed = Date.now() - snapStart;
593:     room.instrumentation.snapshotFetchCount++;
594:     room.instrumentation.snapshotLastLatencyMs = snapElapsed;
595:     const sc = room.instrumentation.snapshotFetchCount;
596:     room.instrumentation.snapshotAvgLatencyMs =
597:       (room.instrumentation.snapshotAvgLatencyMs * (sc - 1) + snapElapsed) / sc;
598:     room.instrumentation.snapshotMaxLatencyMs = Math.max(room.instrumentation.snapshotMaxLatencyMs, snapElapsed);
599:     room.instrumentation.lastSnapshotAt = new Date().toISOString();
600:     return true;
601:   }
602: 
603:   // ─── GET /api/activity-room/v1/activities ────────────────────
604:   // Bounded/paginated historical activity retrieval
605:   if (method === 'GET' && p === '/api/activity-room/v1/activities') {
606:     try {
607:       const query = parseActivityQuery(url);
608:       const page = await room.store.query(query);
609: 
610:       json(res, 200, {
611:         records: page.map(sanitizeRecord),
612:         count: page.length,
613:         limit: query.limit ?? DEFAULT_LIMIT,
614:         // Cursor for next page
615:         nextCursor:
616:           page.length > 0
617:             ? {
618:                 sequenceNumber: page[page.length - 1].sequenceNumber,
619:                 eventId: page[page.length - 1].eventId,
620:                 timestamp: page[page.length - 1].timestamp,
621:               }
622:             : null,
623:       });
624:     } catch (error) {
625:       json(res, 400, {
626:         error: { code: 'INVALID_QUERY', message: error instanceof Error ? error.message : 'Invalid query parameters' },
627:       });
628:     }
629:     return true;
630:   }
631: 
632:   // ─── GET /api/activity-room/v1/activities/after ──────────────
633:   // Cursor-based pagination (M9 sequence-based)
634:   if (method === 'GET' && p === '/api/activity-room/v1/activities/after') {
635:     try {
636:       const params = url.searchParams;
637:       const afterSeq = integer(params.get('afterSequence'));
638:       const afterEventId = stringValue(params.get('afterEventId'));
639:       const afterTimestamp = stringValue(params.get('afterTimestamp'));
640:       const limit = integer(params.get('limit')) ?? DEFAULT_LIMIT;
641: 
642:       if (afterSeq === undefined && !afterTimestamp) {
643:         json(res, 400, {
644:           error: { code: 'MISSING_CURSOR', message: 'afterSequence or afterTimestamp required' },
645:         });
646:         return true;
647:       }
648: 
649:       const cursor: ActivityCursor = {
650:         sequenceNumber: afterSeq ?? 0,
651:         eventId: afterEventId ?? '',
652:         timestamp: afterTimestamp ?? new Date(0).toISOString(),
653:       };
654: 
655:       const records = await room.store.getAfter(cursor);
656:       const limited = records.slice(0, limit);
657: 
658:       json(res, 200, {
659:         records: limited.map(sanitizeRecord),
660:         count: limited.length,
661:         limit,
662:         nextCursor:
663:           limited.length > 0
664:             ? {
665:                 sequenceNumber: limited[limited.length - 1].sequenceNumber,
666:                 eventId: limited[limited.length - 1].eventId,
667:                 timestamp: limited[limited.length - 1].timestamp,
668:               }
669:             : null,
670:       });
671:     } catch (error) {
672:       json(res, 400, {
673:         error: {
674:           code: 'INVALID_CURSOR',
675:           message: error instanceof Error ? error.message : 'Invalid cursor parameters',
676:         },
677:       });
678:     }
679:     return true;
680:   }
681: 
682:   // ─── GET /api/activity-room/v1/activities/:id ────────────────
683:   // Individual ActivityRecord retrieval
684:   if (method === 'GET' && p.match(/^\/api\/activity-room\/v1\/activities\/[^/]+$/)) {
685:     const activityId = decodeURIComponent(p.split('/').pop()!);
686:     const record = await room.store.getByEventId(activityId);
687: 
688:     if (!record) {
689:       json(res, 404, {
690:         error: { code: 'NOT_FOUND', message: `Activity not found: ${activityId}` },
691:       });
692:       return true;
693:     }
694: 
695:     json(res, 200, { record: sanitizeRecord(record) });
696:     return true;
697:   }
698: 
699:   // ─── GET /api/activity-room/v1/activities/aggregate/:id ──────
700:   // Aggregate drill-down using referencedActivityIds / sequenceRange
701:   if (method === 'GET' && p.match(/^\/api\/activity-room\/v1\/activities\/aggregate\/[^/]+$/)) {
702:     const streamItemId = decodeURIComponent(p.split('/').pop()!);
703: 
704:     // Fetch recent records to find the aggregated stream item
705:     const recentRecords = await room.store.query({ limit: 500 });
706:     const projection = room.runtime.rebuild(recentRecords);
707: 
708:     const aggregatedItem = projection.stream.find((s) => s.aggregated !== undefined && s.streamItemId === streamItemId);
709: 
710:     if (!aggregatedItem?.aggregated) {
711:       json(res, 404, {
712:         error: { code: 'NOT_FOUND', message: `Aggregated activity not found: ${streamItemId}` },
713:       });
714:       return true;
715:     }
716: 
717:     // Retrieve all underlying M9 records via referencedActivityIds
718:     const referencedIds = aggregatedItem.aggregated.referencedActivityIds;
719:     const underlyingRecords: M9ActivityRecord[] = [];
720: 
721:     for (const refId of referencedIds) {
722:       const record = await room.store.getByEventId(refId);
723:       if (record) {
724:         underlyingRecords.push(record);
725:       }
726:     }
727: 
728:     // Also support sequenceRange fallback
729:     let rangeRecords: M9ActivityRecord[] = [];
730:     if (underlyingRecords.length === 0 && aggregatedItem.aggregated.sequenceRange) {
731:       const { first, last } = aggregatedItem.aggregated.sequenceRange;
732:       rangeRecords = (await room.store.query({ limit: last - first + 1 })).filter(
733:         (r) => r.sequenceNumber >= first && r.sequenceNumber <= last,
734:       );
735:     }
736: 
737:     const allUnderlying = [...underlyingRecords, ...rangeRecords];
738:     const uniqueRecords = Array.from(new Map(allUnderlying.map((r) => [r.sequenceNumber, r])).values()).sort(
739:       (a, b) => a.sequenceNumber - b.sequenceNumber,
740:     );
741: 
742:     json(res, 200, {
743:       aggregate: {
744:         streamItemId: aggregatedItem.streamItemId,
745:         count: aggregatedItem.aggregated.count,
746:         kind: aggregatedItem.aggregated.kind,
747:         summary: aggregatedItem.aggregated.summary,
748:         sequenceRange: aggregatedItem.aggregated.sequenceRange,
749:       },
750:       underlyingRecords: uniqueRecords.map(sanitizeRecord),
751:       count: uniqueRecords.length,
752:     });
753:     return true;
754:   }
755: 
756:   // ─── GET /api/activity-room/v1/participants ──────────────────
757:   // Participant projection — composed from Agent/Team authority + lifecycle state
758:   if (method === 'GET' && p === '/api/activity-room/v1/participants') {
759:     const participants = await composeParticipants(ctx, room);
760:     json(res, 200, {
761:       participants: participants.map(sanitizeParticipant),
762:       count: participants.length,
763:     });
764:     return true;
765:   }
766: 
767:   // ─── GET /api/activity-room/v1/attention ─────────────────────
768:   // Attention projection
769:   if (method === 'GET' && p === '/api/activity-room/v1/attention') {
770:     if (Date.now() - room.lastProjectionAt > MAX_CURSOR_AGE_MS) {
771:       const records = await room.store.rebuild();
772:       room.lastProjection = room.runtime.rebuild(records);
773:       room.lastProjectionAt = Date.now();
774:     }
775: 
776:     const projection = room.lastProjection!;
777:     json(res, 200, {
778:       attention: projection.attention.map(sanitizeAttention),
779:       count: projection.attention.length,
780:     });
781:     return true;
782:   }
783: 
784:   // ─── GET /api/activity-room/v1/workflow-summary ──────────────
785:   // Workflow summary projection
786:   if (method === 'GET' && p === '/api/activity-room/v1/workflow-summary') {
787:     if (Date.now() - room.lastProjectionAt > MAX_CURSOR_AGE_MS) {
788:       const records = await room.store.rebuild();
789:       room.lastProjection = room.runtime.rebuild(records);
790:       room.lastProjectionAt = Date.now();
791:     }
792: 
793:     const projection = room.lastProjection!;
794:     if (projection.workflowSummary) {
795:       json(res, 200, { workflowSummary: sanitizeWorkflowSummary(projection.workflowSummary) });
796:     } else {
797:       json(res, 200, { workflowSummary: null });
798:     }
799:     return true;
800:   }
801: 
802:   return false;
803: }

37: // ─── M11B Protocol Messages ─────────────────────────────────────
38: 
39: /** Extended message type for M11B protocol (includes ActivityStreamMessage + protocol messages). */
40: type M11BMessage =
41:   | ActivityStreamMessage
42:   | { readonly op: 'subscribed'; readonly cursor: ActivityCursor; readonly frontier: number }
43:   | { readonly op: 'activity'; readonly sequence: number; readonly activity: ProjectionActivityRecord }
44:   | { readonly op: 'catchup-complete'; readonly cursor: ActivityCursor }

48:   | { readonly op: 'unsubscribed' }

53:   readonly send: (message: M11BMessage) => void;

56: interface SubscriberState {

75: function parseClientMessage(data: RawData): ClientMessage | null {
76:   let parsed: unknown;
77:   try {
78:     parsed = JSON.parse(data.toString('utf8'));
79:   } catch {
80:     return null;
81:   }

83:   if (!parsed || typeof parsed !== 'object') return null;

88:       typeof msg.afterSequence === 'number' && Number.isFinite(msg.afterSequence)
89:         ? Math.max(0, Math.floor(msg.afterSequence))
90:         : 0;
91:     return { op: 'subscribe', afterSequence };
92:   }

94:   if (msg.op === 'ack') {
95:     const sequence =
96:       typeof msg.sequence === 'number' && Number.isFinite(msg.sequence) ? Math.max(0, Math.floor(msg.sequence)) : -1;
97:     if (sequence < 0) return null;
98:     return { op: 'ack', sequence };
99:   }
100: 
101:   if (msg.op === 'ping') {
102:     return { op: 'ping' };
103:   }
104: 
105:   if (msg.op === 'unsubscribe') {
106:     return { op: 'unsubscribe' };
107:   }
108: 
109:   return null;

114: function wsSend(ws: WebSocket, data: unknown): void {

154: /**
155:  * M11B Realtime Transport.
156:  * Handles WebSocket connections for the Activity Room realtime stream.
157:  */
158: export class M11BTransport {
159:   private readonly config: M11BTransportConfig;
160:   private readonly subscribers = new Map<string, SubscriberState>();
161:   private heartbeatInterval: NodeJS.Timeout | null = null;
162:   // biome-ignore lint/correctness/noUnusedPrivateClassMembers: retained — false positive, used via runtime

169:   /** Attach to an existing WebSocketServer instance. */
170:   attach(wss: WebSocketServer): void {

243:           wsSend(ws, { op: 'pong' });

269:     });

272:       console.log(`[M11B] Connection ${connectionId} closed: ${code} ${reason.toString().slice(0, 100)}`);
273:       if (subscriber) {

275:       }
276:     });
277: 
278:     ws.on('error', (err: Error) => {
279:       console.error(`[M11B] Connection ${connectionId} error:`, err);
280:       if (subscriber) {

285:     // Store subscriber reference for cleanup

298:   /** Handle subscription request with cursor-based catch-up. */
299:   private async handleSubscribe(connectionId: string, ws: WebSocket, afterSequence: number): Promise<void> {

303:     // Create M11B sink wrapper that handles both ActivityStreamMessage and M11B protocol messages
304:     const m11bSink: M11BSink = {
305:       send: (message: M11BMessage) => {
306:         if (ws.readyState === WebSocket.OPEN) {

320:     }

322:     // CRITICAL RACE HANDLING:
323:     // 1. Client has snapshot at cursor C (from M11A /snapshot)
324:     // 2. Before WebSocket subscription completes, activity C+1 is appended
325:     // 3. We must deliver C+1 exactly once through catch-up/live handoff
326:     //
327:     // Solution: Attach to hub at the TRUE latest frontier FIRST (so live
328:     // delivery captures everything), then replay history up to that frontier.
329:     // The hub will deliver in-order from the checkpoint, so no gaps/duplicates.
330: 
331:     // Get the true latest frontier from M9 store
332:     let frontier = afterSequence;
333:     try {
334:       frontier = await room.store.lastSequence();
335:     } catch {
336:       // Fall back to subscriber's checkpoint
337:     }

339:     // Create the subscriber state

341:     // Transform ActivityStreamMessage (type field) → M11BMessage (op field)
342:     // so the client receives the expected wire format.

349:           } else if (msg.type === 'activity.resync-required') {
350:             m11bSink.send({
351:               op: 'resync-required',
352:               earliestAvailableSequence: msg.earliestAvailableSequence,
353:               latestSequence: msg.latestSequence,
354:             });
355:           }
356:         },
357:       },
358:       afterSequence,
359:       bufferCapacity: this.config.bufferCapacity,
360:       onResync: (conn) => this.handleResync(connectionId, conn),
361:     });
362: 
363:     const subscriber: SubscriberState = {

78:     if (!this.closedFlag) this.sink.send(message);
79:   }
80: 
81:   close(): void {
82:     this.closedFlag = true;
83:     this.pending = [];
84:   }
85: 
86:   /** Deliver one persisted record in stream order. */
87:   deliver(record: ActivityRecord): ActivityDeliveryResult {
88:     if (this.closedFlag) return 'duplicate';
89:     if (record.sequence <= this.checkpoint) return 'duplicate';
90:     if (record.sequence === this.checkpoint + 1) {
91:       this.emit(record);
92:       this.flush();
93:       return this.resyncRequested ? 'resync' : 'delivered';
94:     }
95:     // Gap in sequence: hold until the missing records arrive.
96:     this.pending.push(record);
97:     if (this.pending.length > this.capacity) {
98:       this.requestResync();
99:       return 'resync';
100:     }
101:     return 'held';
102:   }
103: 
104:   private emit(record: ActivityRecord): void {
105:     this.sink.send({ type: 'activity.appended', sequence: record.sequence, activity: record });
106:     this.checkpoint = record.sequence;
107:   }
108: 
109:   private flush(): void {
110:     while (this.pending.length > 0 && this.pending[0]?.sequence === this.checkpoint + 1) {
111:       const next = this.pending.shift();
112:       if (next !== undefined) this.emit(next);
113:     }
114:   }

116:   private requestResync(): void {

118:     this.resyncRequested = true;
119:     this.pending = [];

121:   }
122: }

135:  * `activity.resync-required` directive and is detached until it re-subscribes
136:  * from a fresh checkpoint.
137:  */

139:   private readonly connections = new Map<string, ActivityStreamConnection>();
140:   private readonly earliestAvailableSequence: number;
141:   private readonly bufferCapacity: number;
142:   private latestSequence = 0;
143: 
144:   constructor(options: ActivityStreamHubOptions = {}) {
145:     this.earliestAvailableSequence = Math.max(1, options.earliestAvailableSequence ?? 1);
146:     this.bufferCapacity = options.bufferCapacity ?? 128;
147:   }
148: 
149:   /** Attach (or re-attach) a client at its recovered checkpoint. */
150:   attach(id: string, sink: ActivityStreamSink, afterSequence = 0): ActivityStreamConnection {
151:     this.detach(id);
152:     const connection = new ActivityStreamConnection({
153:       id,
154:       sink,
155:       afterSequence,
156:       bufferCapacity: this.bufferCapacity,
157:       onResync: (connectionToResync) => this.handleResync(connectionToResync),

163:   detach(id: string): void {

165:     if (connection !== undefined) connection.close();
166:     this.connections.delete(id);
167:   }
168: 
169:   isAttached(id: string): boolean {

171:   }
172: 
173:   /** Highest sequence delivered to a connection, or 0 when not attached. */
174:   checkpoint(id: string): number {

180:   }

184:   }
185: 
186:   get connectionCount(): number {

188:   }
189: 
190:   /** Broadcast a persisted record to every attached connection, exactly once each. */
191:   broadcast(record: ActivityRecord): void {
192:     if (record.sequence > this.latestSequence) this.latestSequence = record.sequence;
193:     for (const connection of [...this.connections.values()]) {
194:       if (connection.deliver(record) === 'resync') {
195:         connection.send({

197:           earliestAvailableSequence: this.earliestAvailableSequence,
198:           latestSequence: this.latestSequence,
199:         });
200:         this.detach(connection.id);
201:       }
202:     }
203:   }

26:  * effective state.

28:  * Lifecycle contract:
29:  * - Scope change resets every source BEFORE new-scope data applies; superseded
30:  *   responses are dropped by a monotonic request id (race guard).
31:  * - A failed refresh after a successful one surfaces `stale` with the prior
32:  *   data, never silently-current.
33:  * - Polling shares one cadence and only runs while the document is visible.
34:  */

36:   stream: ActivityStreamSnapshot;
37:   participants: AuxiliarySource<readonly WorkflowParticipant[]>;
38:   liveStream: AuxiliarySource<readonly LiveStreamItem[]>;

44: /** Merge a fetch result into a source, honoring the stale-after-success rule. */
45: function mergeResult<T>(previous: AuxiliarySource<T>, result: { data?: T; error?: string }, active: boolean): AuxiliarySource<T> {
46:   if (!active) return { status: 'idle' };
47:   if (result.error === undefined && result.data !== undefined) {
48:     return { status: 'ready', data: result.data, updatedAt: Date.now() };
49:   }
50:   const error = result.error ?? 'Unknown error';
51:   if (previous.status === 'ready' || previous.status === 'stale') {
52:     return { ...previous, status: 'stale', error, updatedAt: Date.now() };
53:   }
54:   return { status: 'error', error };
55: }
56: 
57: export function useActivityRoomModel(): ActivityRoomModel {

59:

83:     setLiveStream((previous) => mergeResult(previous, liveResult, workflowId !== undefined));
84:     setReceipts((previous) => mergeResult(previous, receiptsResult, workflowId !== undefined));

1: /**
2:  * M11C Activity Room Hook
3:  *
4:  * Composes the frozen M11A HTTP read API and M11B WebSocket protocol into
5:  * a single React hook that manages the complete Activity Room lifecycle:
6:  *
7:  *   HTTP snapshot → cursor C → WS subscribe(C) → catch-up → LIVE
8:  *   → disconnect → RECONNECTING → subscribe(lastSeq) → catch-up → LIVE
9:  *
10:  * Authority flow: M9 durable truth → M10 projection → M11A/M11B → this hook → UI
11:  *
12:  * No alternative Activity Room state source, polling loop, mock participant
13:  * system, or UI-owned workflow state is introduced.
14:  */
15:

17: import type { InteractionResponse } from '@vestara/types';

32: const SNAPSHOT_LIMIT = 50;

35: const HISTORY_PAGE_SIZE = 50;

162:   readonly submitResponse: (interactionId: string, choiceId: string) => Promise<void>;
163: }

166: 
167: function streamItemFromSnapshot(item: M11AStreamItem): M11CStreamItem {
168:   return {
169:     id: item.streamItemId,
170:     sequence: item.sequenceNumber,
171:     timestamp: item.timestamp,
172:     kind: item.kind,
173:     importance: item.importance,
174:     actor: item.actor,
175:     content: item.content,
176:     workflowRunId: item.workflowRunId,
177:     executionId: item.executionId,
178:     taskId: item.taskId,
179:     aggregated: item.aggregated,
180:     fresh: false,
181:     interaction: item.interaction,
182:     referencedActivityIds: item.referencedActivityIds,
183:   };
184: }

186: function streamItemFromLive(activity: M11AActivityRecord, fresh: boolean = true): M11CStreamItem {
187:   // Map M9 type to stream kind (simplified — full mapping lives in M10)
188:   const kindMap: Record<string, string> = {
189:     'workflow.started': 'activity',
190:     'workflow.completed': 'activity',
191:     'workflow.failed': 'activity',
192:     'workflow.cancelled': 'activity',
193:     'task.runnable': 'activity',
194:     'task.started': 'activity',
195:     'task.completed': 'activity',
196:     'task.failed': 'activity',
197:     'task.cancelled': 'activity',
198:     'agent.assigned': 'conversation',
199:     'agent.started': 'activity',
200:     'agent.progress': 'progress',
201:     'agent.waiting': 'activity',
202:     'agent.completed': 'activity',
203:     'agent.failed': 'activity',
204:     'agent.cancelled': 'activity',
205:     'tool.called': 'tool-call',
206:     'tool.succeeded': 'tool-result',
207:     'tool.failed': 'tool-result',
208:     'human.message': 'conversation',
209:     'system.event': 'log',
210:     'interaction.presented': 'interaction',
211:     'interaction.responded': 'interaction',
212:   };
213: 
214:   // Derive importance from kind (simplified — full mapping lives in M10)
215:   const kind = kindMap[activity.type] ?? 'activity';
216:   const importance: M11CStreamItem['importance'] =
217:     kind === 'conversation' ? 'primary' :
218:     kind === 'interaction' && activity.type === 'interaction.presented' ? 'primary' :
219:     kind === 'interaction' && activity.type === 'interaction.responded' ? 'secondary' :
220:     kind === 'log' || kind === 'telemetry' ? 'muted' :
221:     'secondary';
222: 
223:   const base: M11CStreamItem = {
224:     id: activity.activityId,
225:     sequence: activity.sequenceNumber,
226:     timestamp: activity.timestamp,
227:     kind,
228:     importance,
229:     actor: {
230:       type: activity.actor.type,
231:       id: activity.actor.id,
232:       displayName: activity.actor.displayName,
233:       ...(activity.actorId ? { role: activity.actorId } : {}),
234:     },
235:     content: activity.payload?.message ?? '',
236:     workflowRunId: activity.workflowRunId,
237:     executionId: activity.executionId,
238:     taskId: activity.taskId,
239:     fresh,
240:     referencedActivityIds: activity.referencedActivityIds,
241:   };
242: 
243:   // Carry interaction data for live arrival
244:   if (kind === 'interaction' && activity.payload?.data) {
245:     const data = activity.payload.data as Record<string, unknown>;
246:     const interactionId = typeof data.interactionId === 'string' ? data.interactionId : undefined;
247:     if (interactionId) {
248:       const lifecycle = activity.type === 'interaction.responded' ? 'responded' as const : 'presented' as const;
249:       const choices = Array.isArray(data.choices)
250:         ? (data.choices as readonly { choiceId: string; label: string; description?: string }[])
251:         : undefined;
252:       const selectedChoiceId = typeof data.selectedChoiceId === 'string' ? data.selectedChoiceId : undefined;
253:       const respondingParticipantId = lifecycle === 'responded' ? activity.actor.id : undefined;
254:       const respondingParticipantName = lifecycle === 'responded' ? activity.actor.displayName : undefined;
255: 
256:       return {
257:         ...base,
258:         interaction: {
259:           interactionId,
260:           lifecycle,
261:           ...(choices ? { choices } : {}),
262:           ...(selectedChoiceId ? { selectedChoiceId } : {}),
263:           ...(respondingParticipantId ? { respondingParticipantId } : {}),
264:           ...(respondingParticipantName ? { respondingParticipantName } : {}),
265:         },
266:       };
267:     }
268:   }
269: 
270:   return base;
271: }
272: 
273: function compareBySequence(a: M11CStreamItem, b: M11CStreamItem): number {
274:   return a.sequence - b.sequence;
275: }
276: 
277: // ─── Hook ────────────────────────────────────────────────────
278: 
279: export function useM11CActivityRoom(): M11CActivityRoom {
280:   // ─── State ──────────────────────────────────────────────
281:   const [state, setState] = useState<M11CConnectionState>('connecting');
282:   const [room, setRoom] = useState<{ readonly roomId: string; readonly name: string } | null>(null);
283:   const [cursor, setCursor] = useState<M11CActivityRoom['cursor']>(null);
284:   const [participants, setParticipants] = useState<readonly ParticipantProjection[]>([]);
285:   const [stream, setStream] = useState<readonly M11CStreamItem[]>([]);
286:   const [workflowSummary, setWorkflowSummary] = useState<WorkflowSummary | null>(null);
287:   const [attention, setAttention] = useState<readonly AttentionEntry[]>([]);
288:   const [latestSequence, setLatestSequence] = useState(0);
289:   const [unread, setUnread] = useState(0);
290:   const [loadingHistory, setLoadingHistory] = useState(false);
291:   const [olderLoaded, setOlderLoaded] = useState(0);
292:   const [error, setError] = useState<string | undefined>(undefined);
293:   const [paused, setPaused] = useState(false);
294:   const [freshIds, setFreshIds] = useState<ReadonlySet<string>>(new Set());
295:   const [submission, setSubmission] = useState<SubmissionState>({ status: 'idle' });
296:   const [retryKey, setRetryKey] = useState(0);
297: 
298:   // ─── Refs ───────────────────────────────────────────────
299:   const latestSequenceRef = useRef(0);
300:   const pausedRef = useRef(false);
301:   const atBottomRef = useRef(true);
302:   const unreadRef = useRef(0);
303:   const loadingOlderRef = useRef(false);
304:   const liveBufferRef = useRef<M11CStreamItem[]>([]);
305:   const flushTimerRef = useRef<number | null>(null);
306:   const disposedRef = useRef(false);
307:   const clientRef = useRef<M11BClient>(m11bClient);
308:   const submissionRef = useRef<SubmissionState>({ status: 'idle' });
309: 
310:   // ─── Derived ────────────────────────────────────────────
311: 
312:   const bumpUnread = useCallback(() => {
313:     unreadRef.current += 1;
314:     setUnread(unreadRef.current);
315:   }, []);
316: 
317:   const clearUnread = useCallback(() => {
318:     unreadRef.current = 0;
319:     setUnread(0);
320:   }, []);
321: 
322:   /** Merge a batch of items into the stream, deduplicating by id. */
323:   const mergeStream = useCallback((items: readonly M11CStreamItem[]) => {
324:     if (items.length === 0) return;
325:     setStream((previous) => {
326:       const known = new Set(previous.map((item) => item.id));
327:       const additions = items.filter((item) => !known.has(item.id));
328:       if (additions.length === 0) return previous;
329:       const merged = [...previous, ...additions].sort(compareBySequence);
330:       // Bound the working set — drop oldest if over limit
331:       if (merged.length > MAX_WORKING_SET) {
332:         return merged.slice(merged.length - MAX_WORKING_SET);
333:       }
334:       return merged;
335:     });
336:   }, []);
337: 
338:   /** Update latest sequence from a batch. */
339:   const updateSequence = useCallback((seq: number) => {
340:     if (seq > latestSequenceRef.current) {
341:       latestSequenceRef.current = seq;
342:       setLatestSequence(seq);
343:     }
344:   }, []);
345: 
346:   // ─── Actions ────────────────────────────────────────────
347: 
348:   const reportViewport = useCallback(
349:     (atBottom: boolean) => {
350:       atBottomRef.current = atBottom;
351:       if (atBottom) clearUnread();
352:     },
353:     [clearUnread],
354:   );
355: 
356:   const pause = useCallback(() => {
357:     if (pausedRef.current) return;
358:     pausedRef.current = true;
359:     setPaused(true);
360:   }, []);
361: 
362:   const resume = useCallback(() => {
363:     if (!pausedRef.current) return;
364:     pausedRef.current = false;
365:     setPaused(false);
366:     // Flush buffered live items
367:     const buffered = liveBufferRef.current;
368:     liveBufferRef.current = [];
369:     if (flushTimerRef.current !== null) {
370:       window.clearTimeout(flushTimerRef.current);
371:       flushTimerRef.current = null;
372:     }
373:     if (buffered.length > 0) mergeStream(buffered);
374:     clearUnread();
375:   }, [mergeStream, clearUnread]);
376: 
377:   const loadOlder = useCallback(async () => {
378:     if (stream.length === 0 || loadingOlderRef.current) return;
379:     const oldest = Math.min(...stream.map((item) => item.sequence));
380:     loadingOlderRef.current = true;
381:     setLoadingHistory(true);
382:     try {
383:       const response = await fetchM11AActivities({ beforeSequence: oldest, limit: HISTORY_PAGE_SIZE });
384:       if (disposedRef.current) return;
385:       const older = response.records.map((record) => streamItemFromLive(record, false));
386:       const known = new Set(stream.map((item) => item.id));
387:       const uniqueOlder = older.filter((item) => !known.has(item.id));
388:       if (uniqueOlder.length > 0) {
389:         // Prepend older records (preserving sort order)
390:         setStream((previous) => {
391:           const merged = [...uniqueOlder, ...previous].sort(compareBySequence);
392:           if (merged.length > MAX_WORKING_SET) {
393:             return merged.slice(merged.length - MAX_WORKING_SET);
394:           }
395:           return merged;
396:         });
397:         setOlderLoaded((prev) => prev + uniqueOlder.length);
398:       }
399:     } catch (err) {
400:       if (!disposedRef.current) {
401:         setError(err instanceof Error ? err.message : 'Failed to load history');
402:       }
403:     } finally {
404:       loadingOlderRef.current = false;
405:       setLoadingHistory(false);
406:     }
407:   }, [stream]);
408: 
409:   const clear = useCallback(() => {
410:     setStream([]);
411:     setLatestSequence(0);
412:     latestSequenceRef.current = 0;
413:     setUnread(0);
414:     unreadRef.current = 0;
415:     setFreshIds(new Set());
416:     setOlderLoaded(0);
417:     setError(undefined);
418:     liveBufferRef.current = [];
419:     if (flushTimerRef.current !== null) {
420:       window.clearTimeout(flushTimerRef.current);
421:       flushTimerRef.current = null;
422:     }
423:   }, []);
424: 
425:   const retry = useCallback(() => {
426:     clear();
427:     setError(undefined);
428:     // Increment retryKey to force the WebSocket lifecycle useEffect to re-run
429:     // with a fresh snapshot fetch and WS reconnect
430:     setRetryKey((k) => k + 1);
431:   }, [clear]);
432: 
433:   // ─── AR-REC-R6: Interaction Response Submission ──────────
434: 
435:   /**
436:    * Submit a human response to a structured interaction.
437:    *
438:    * Data flow:
439:    *   DecisionOption → ChoiceId → onSelect → submitResponse
440:    *   → POST /api/interactions/:id/responses { choiceId }
441:    *   → InteractionService → durable InteractionResponse
442:    *   → interaction:responded → M9→M10→M11B → durable presented state
443:    *
444:    * Race condition handling:
445:    *   - Order A: HTTP success → transient accepted → live responded → durable wins
446:    *   - Order B: live responded → durable wins → HTTP callback → no regression
447:    *   - Near-simultaneous: convergence via submission interactionId check
448:    *
449:    * Convergence invariant:
450:    *   Once lifecycle === 'responded' is observed in the stream for this
451:    *   interactionId, transient state is cleared regardless of HTTP timing.
452:    */
453:   const submitResponse = useCallback(async (interactionId: string, choiceId: string) => {
454:     // Double-click suppression (UX only — server UNIQUE constraint is authority)
455:     if (submission.status === 'submitting' && submission.interactionId === interactionId) {
456:       return;
457:     }
458: 
459:     setSubmission({ status: 'submitting', interactionId, choiceId });
460: 
461:     try {
462:       const result = await submitInteractionResponse(interactionId, choiceId);
463: 
464:       // Check if durable state already arrived via live event (Order B convergence)
465:       const streamHasResponded = stream.some(
466:         (item) =>
467:           item.interaction?.interactionId === interactionId && item.interaction?.lifecycle === 'responded',
468:       );
469: 
470:       if (streamHasResponded) {
471:         // Durable state already wins — clear transient, don't show accepted
472:         setSubmission({ status: 'idle' });
473:       } else {
474:         // HTTP success before live event (Order A) — show accepted transiently
475:         setSubmission({ status: 'accepted', interactionId, response: result.response });
476:       }
477:     } catch (err) {
478:       // Check if durable state arrived despite error (Order B convergence)
479:       const streamHasResponded = stream.some(
480:         (item) =>
481:           item.interaction?.interactionId === interactionId && item.interaction?.lifecycle === 'responded',
482:       );
483: 
484:       if (streamHasResponded) {
485:         // Durable state already wins — ignore transient error
486:         setSubmission({ status: 'idle' });
487:         return;
488:       }
489: 
490:       const classified = classifySubmissionError(err);
491:       setSubmission({
492:         status: 'failure',
493:         interactionId,
494:         error: classified.message,
495:         retryable: classified.retryable,
496:       });
497:     }
498:   }, [submission, stream]);
499: 
500:   // ─── Live Activity Handler ──────────────────────────────
501: 
502:   // Keep submissionRef in sync with submission state (avoids re-creating handleLiveActivity)
503:   useEffect(() => {
504:     submissionRef.current = submission;
505:   }, [submission]);
506: 
507:   const handleLiveActivity = useCallback(
508:     (activity: M11AActivityRecord, sequence: number) => {
509:       const item = streamItemFromLive(activity, true);
510: 
511:       // AR-REC-R6: Convergence — when durable responded arrives, clear transient submission
512:       // Read from ref to avoid adding submission to dependency array (prevents WS teardown)
513:       const currentSubmission = submissionRef.current;
514:       if (
515:         activity.type === 'interaction.responded' &&
516:         currentSubmission.status !== 'idle' &&
517:         currentSubmission.interactionId === item.interaction?.interactionId
518:       ) {
519:         // Durable state wins — clear transient submission
520:         setSubmission({ status: 'idle' });
521:       }
522: 
523:       if (pausedRef.current) {
524:         // Buffer while paused
525:         if (!liveBufferRef.current.some((existing) => existing.id === item.id)) {
526:           liveBufferRef.current.push(item);
527:         }
528:         bumpUnread();
529:         return;
530:       }
531: 
532:       if (!atBottomRef.current) bumpUnread();
533: 
534:       // Mark as fresh for animation
535:       setFreshIds((prev) => (prev.has(item.id) ? prev : new Set(prev).add(item.id)));
536: 
537:       // Buffer live arrivals for batch rendering
538:       liveBufferRef.current.push(item);
539:       if (flushTimerRef.current === null) {
540:         flushTimerRef.current = window.setTimeout(() => {
541:           flushTimerRef.current = null;
542:           const buffered = liveBufferRef.current;
543:           liveBufferRef.current = [];
544:           mergeStream(buffered);
545:         }, LIVE_BATCH_MS);
546:       }
547: 
548:       updateSequence(sequence);
549:     },
550:     [bumpUnread, mergeStream, updateSequence],
551:   );
552: 
553:   // ─── WebSocket Lifecycle ────────────────────────────────
554: 
555:   useEffect(() => {
556:     disposedRef.current = false;
557:     const client = clientRef.current;
558: 
559:     // Register WebSocket listeners
560:     const offActivity = client.onActivity((activity, sequence) => {
561:       if (!disposedRef.current) handleLiveActivity(activity, sequence);
562:     });
563: 
564:     const offState = client.onState((wsState: M11BConnectionState) => {
565:       if (disposedRef.current) return;
566:       if (pausedRef.current) return; // Local pause overrides WS state
567:       setState(wsState);
568:     });
569: 
570:     const offSubscribed = client.onSubscribed((_cursor, _frontier) => {
571:       if (!disposedRef.current) setError(undefined);
572:     });
573: 
574:     const offCatchupComplete = client.onCatchupComplete((_cursor) => {
575:       // Catch-up complete — transition to LIVE
576:       if (!disposedRef.current) {
577:         setState(pausedRef.current ? 'paused' : 'live');
578:       }
579:     });
580: 
581:     const offResync = client.onResync((earliestAvailableSequence, _latestSequence) => {
582:       if (disposedRef.current) return;
583:       setError('Stream fell behind; resynchronizing…');
584:       // Re-fetch snapshot and re-subscribe
585:       void (async () => {
586:         try {
587:           const snapshot = await fetchM11ASnapshot();
588:           if (disposedRef.current) return;
589:           // Apply snapshot
590:           setRoom(snapshot.room);
591:           setCursor(snapshot.cursor);
592:           setParticipants(snapshot.participants);
593:           setWorkflowSummary(snapshot.workflowSummary);
594:           setAttention(snapshot.attention);
595:           const items = snapshot.stream.map(streamItemFromSnapshot);
596:           setStream(items);
597:           updateSequence(snapshot.cursor.sequenceNumber);
598:           // Re-subscribe from new cursor
599:           client.connect(snapshot.cursor.sequenceNumber);
600:         } catch {
601:           if (!disposedRef.current) setError('Resync failed. Retrying…');
602:         }
603:       })();
604:     });
605: 
606:     const offError = client.onError((_code, message) => {
607:       if (!disposedRef.current) setError(message);
608:     });
609: 
610:     const offHeartbeat = client.onHeartbeat(() => {
611:       // Heartbeat received — connection is alive
612:     });
613: 
614:     // ─── Initial Snapshot Fetch ───────────────────────────
615: 
616:     void (async () => {
617:       try {
618:         const snapshot = await fetchM11ASnapshot();
619:         if (disposedRef.current) return;
620: 
621:         // Apply snapshot state
622:         setRoom(snapshot.room);
623:         setCursor(snapshot.cursor);
624:         setParticipants(snapshot.participants);
625:         setWorkflowSummary(snapshot.workflowSummary);
626:         setAttention(snapshot.attention);
627: 
628:         const items = snapshot.stream.map(streamItemFromSnapshot);
629:         setStream(items);
630:         updateSequence(snapshot.cursor.sequenceNumber);
631: 
632:         // Subscribe via WebSocket from cursor sequence
633:         client.connect(snapshot.cursor.sequenceNumber);
634:       } catch (err) {
635:         if (!disposedRef.current) {
636:           setError(err instanceof Error ? err.message : 'Failed to load Activity Room');
637:           setState('error');
638:         }
639:       }
640:     })();
641: 
642:     // ─── Cleanup ──────────────────────────────────────────
643: 
644:     return () => {
645:       disposedRef.current = true;
646:       offActivity();
647:       offState();
648:       offSubscribed();
649:       offCatchupComplete();
650:       offResync();
651:       offError();
652:       offHeartbeat();
653:       client.disconnect();
654:       if (flushTimerRef.current !== null) {
655:         window.clearTimeout(flushTimerRef.current);
656:         flushTimerRef.current = null;
657:       }
658:       liveBufferRef.current = [];
659:     };
660:   }, [handleLiveActivity, updateSequence, retryKey]);
661: 
662:   // ─── Prune freshIds after animation completes ───────────
663:   // Prevents unbounded growth during long sessions. Entries older than
664:   // FRESH_TTL_MS are removed so the Set stays bounded.
665: 
666:   const FRESH_TTL_MS = 5_000;
667:   const pruneTimerRef = useRef<number | null>(null);
668: 
669:   useEffect(() => {
670:     // Schedule a prune whenever freshIds is non-empty
671:     if (freshIds.size > 0 && pruneTimerRef.current === null) {
672:       pruneTimerRef.current = window.setTimeout(() => {
673:         pruneTimerRef.current = null;
674:         setFreshIds(new Set());
675:       }, FRESH_TTL_MS);
676:     }
677: 
678:     return () => {
679:       if (pruneTimerRef.current !== null) {
680:         window.clearTimeout(pruneTimerRef.current);
681:         pruneTimerRef.current = null;
682:       }
683:     };
684:   }, [freshIds.size]);
685: 
686:   // ─── Map connection state ──────────────────────────────
687: 
688:   const mappedState: M11CConnectionState = paused
689:     ? 'paused'
690:     : state === 'offline'
691:       ? 'offline'
692:       : state === 'reconnecting'
693:         ? 'reconnecting'
694:         : state === 'connecting'
695:           ? 'connecting'
696:           : error
697:             ? 'error'
698:             : 'live';
699: 
700:   return {
701:     state: mappedState,
702:     room,
703:     cursor,
704:     participants,
705:     stream,
706:     workflowSummary,
707:     attention,
708:     latestSequence,

724:   };

/**
 * M11C Activity Room Hook
 *
 * Composes the frozen M11A HTTP read API and M11B WebSocket protocol into
 * a single React hook that manages the complete Activity Room lifecycle:
 *
 *   HTTP snapshot → cursor C → WS subscribe(C) → catch-up → LIVE
 *   → disconnect → RECONNECTING → subscribe(lastSeq) → catch-up → LIVE
 *
 * Authority flow: M9 durable truth → M10 projection → M11A/M11B → this hook → UI
 *
 * No alternative Activity Room state source, polling loop, mock participant
 * system, or UI-owned workflow state is introduced.
 */

1: /**
2:  * M11C Activity Room UI State Hook
3:  *
4:  * Consolidates modal, drawer, and transient UI state for the Activity Room
5:  * page. Replaces 5+ individual useState calls with a single reducer that
6:  * guarantees mutual exclusivity (only one modal/drawer open at a time).
7:  *
8:  * State categories:
9:  *   - Modals: detail, edit, thread (mutually exclusive)
10:  *   - Drawers: agent control (mutually exclusive with modals)
11:  *   - Composer: reply-to (can coexist with other state)

/**
 * M11C Activity Room Page
 *
 * Production Activity Room UI Shell + Live Read Surface.
 * Consumes frozen M11A HTTP read API and M11B WebSocket protocol.
 *
 * Authority flow: M9 durable truth → M10 projection → M11A/M11B → this page → UI
 *
 * No alternative Activity Room state source, polling loop, mock participant
 * system, or UI-owned workflow state is introduced.
 *
 * Acceptance criteria:
 * 1. Renders entirely from M11A/M11B production contracts
 * 2. Zero hardcoded participants
 * 3. Snapshot → catch-up → live produces no visible duplication
 * 4. Disconnect/reconnect requires no reload
 * 5. resync-required performs controlled resynchronization
 * 6. Historical pages load independently from M10's 500-item working set
 * 7. Older-history prepend preserves viewport position
 * 8. Incoming activity does not steal scroll position when reading history

/**
 * M11C Workflow Browser Column
 *
 * A center-left column (~280px) showing active workflows/sessions with their
 * latest disposition, event counts, and last activity. The navigation plane
 * for scope and at-a-glance health of every workstream.
 *
 * Design spec: activity-room-visual-design-spec.md §2.3
 *   - Target width: ~280px (±16px)
 *   - Content: unit list, scope selector, execution pulse
 *   - At <768px becomes a bottom sheet
 *
 * Authority: derives from M11C stream items and workflow summary projection.
 * No state mutation — pure projection.
 */

import { useMemo, useState } from 'react';
import type { M11CStreamItem } from '../../hooks/useM11CActivityRoom';
import type { WorkflowSummary } from '@vestara/activity-room';
import { StatusIndicator, type StatusVariant } from '@vestara/ui';

1: /**
2:  * M11A Production Activity Room Read API Client
3:  *
4:  * Consumes frozen M11A HTTP endpoints. Read-only — no mutation of M8/M9/M10.
5:  * Authority flow: M9 durable truth → M10 projection → M11A API → this client → UI
6:  */
7: 
8: import type {
9:   ActivityCursor,
10:   ActivityRecord as M9ActivityRecord,
11:   ActivityRoomProjection,
12:   AttentionEntry,
13:   InteractionResponse,
14:   ParticipantProjection,
15:   WorkflowSummary,
16: } from '@vestara/types';
17: import { resolveHttpUrl } from './clientConfig';
18: 
19: // ─── Types ───────────────────────────────────────────────────
20: 
21: export interface M11ASnapshot {
22:   room: ActivityRoomProjection['room'];
23:   participants: readonly ParticipantProjection[];
24:   stream: readonly M11AStreamItem[];
25:   workflowSummary: WorkflowSummary | null;
26:   attention: readonly AttentionEntry[];
27:   contextualCapabilities: ActivityRoomProjection['contextualCapabilities'];
28:   cursor: ActivityCursor;
29: }
30: 
31: export interface M11AStreamItem {
32:   readonly streamItemId: string;
33:   readonly activityId: string;
34:   readonly sequenceNumber: number;
35:   readonly kind: string;
36:   readonly importance: 'primary' | 'secondary' | 'muted';
37:   readonly actor: { readonly type: string; readonly id: string; readonly displayName: string; readonly role?: string };
38:   readonly content: string;
39:   readonly timestamp: string;
40:   readonly workflowRunId?: string;
41:   readonly executionId?: string;
42:   readonly taskId?: string;
43:   readonly aggregated?: {
44:     readonly count: number;
45:     readonly kind: string;
46:     readonly summary: string;
47:     readonly referencedActivityIds: readonly string[];
48:     readonly sequenceRange: { readonly first: number; readonly last: number };
49:   };
50:   readonly interaction?: {
51:     readonly interactionId: string;
52:     readonly lifecycle: 'presented' | 'responded';
53:     readonly choices?: readonly { readonly choiceId: string; readonly label: string; readonly description?: string }[];
54:     readonly selectedChoiceId?: string;
55:     readonly respondingParticipantId?: string;
56:     readonly respondingParticipantName?: string;
57:   };
58: }
59: 
60: export interface M11AActivityRecord {
61:   readonly activityId: string;
62:   readonly eventId: string;
63:   readonly sequenceNumber: number;
64:   readonly type: string;
65:   readonly timestamp: string;
66:   readonly executionId?: string;
67:   readonly traceId?: string;
68:   readonly requestId?: string;
69:   readonly workflowRunId?: string;
70:   readonly taskId?: string;
71:   readonly agentAssignmentId?: string;
72:   readonly repositoryBindingId?: string;
73:   readonly runtimeSessionBindingId?: string;
74:   readonly aiBindingId?: string;
75:   readonly actor: { readonly type: string; readonly id: string; readonly displayName: string };
76:   readonly actorId?: string;
77:   readonly source: string;
78:   readonly payload?: { readonly message?: string; readonly error?: string; readonly output?: unknown };
79:   readonly visibility: string;
80: }

83:   readonly records: readonly M11AActivityRecord[];
84:   readonly count: number;
85:   readonly limit: number;
86:   readonly nextCursor: ActivityCursor | null;
87: }
88: 
89: export interface M11AError {
90:   readonly code: string;
91:   readonly message: string;
92: }
93: 
94: // ─── HTTP Client ─────────────────────────────────────────────
95: 
96: async function m11aFetch<T>(path: string, init?: RequestInit): Promise<T> {
97:   const url = resolveHttpUrl(path);
98:   const res = await fetch(url, {
99:     headers: { 'Content-Type': 'application/json' },
100:     ...init,
101:   });
102:   if (!res.ok) {
103:     let detail = `HTTP ${res.status}`;
104:     try {
105:       const body = (await res.json()) as { error?: M11AError };
106:       if (body?.error?.message) detail = body.error.message;
107:     } catch {
108:       /* keep HTTP detail */
109:     }
110:     throw new Error(detail);
111:   }
112:   return res.json() as Promise<T>;
113: }
114: 
115: // ─── Snapshot ────────────────────────────────────────────────
116:

118:  * Fetch the room snapshot + authoritative cursor.
119:  * This is the first call in the HTTP snapshot → WS subscribe lifecycle.
120:  */
121: export async function fetchM11ASnapshot(): Promise<M11ASnapshot> {
122:   return m11aFetch<M11ASnapshot>('/api/activity-room/v1/snapshot');
123: }
124: 
125: // ─── Historical Activities ───────────────────────────────────
126: 
127: export interface M11AActivityQuery {
128:   workflowRunId?: string;
129:   executionId?: string;
130:   taskId?: string;
131:   actorType?: string;
132:   actorId?: string;
133:   type?: string;
134:   source?: string;
135:   afterSequence?: number;
136:   beforeSequence?: number;
137:   limit?: number;
138: }
139: 
140: /**
141:  * Fetch bounded/paginated historical activities.
142:  * Used for scroll-up history loading and initial hydration.
143:  */
144: export async function fetchM11AActivities(query: M11AActivityQuery = {}): Promise<M11AActivitiesResponse> {
145:   const params = new URLSearchParams();
146:   for (const [key, value] of Object.entries(query)) {
147:     if (value !== undefined) params.set(key, String(value));
148:   }

151: }
152: 
153: /**
154:  * Fetch activities after a specific cursor (for catch-up/recovery).
155:  */
156: export async function fetchM11AActivitiesAfter(
157:   afterSequence: number,
158:   limit: number = 100,
159: ): Promise<M11AActivitiesResponse> {

162: 
163: /**
164:  * Fetch an individual activity record by eventId.
165:  */
166: export async function fetchM11AActivityById(eventId: string): Promise<M11AActivityRecord> {
167:   return m11aFetch<M11AActivityRecord>(`/api/activity-room/v1/activities/${encodeURIComponent(eventId)}`);
168: }
169: 
170: /**
171:  * Fetch aggregate drill-down by stream item activityId.
172:  */
173: export async function fetchM11AAggregateDrillDown(
174:   aggregateId: string,
175: ): Promise<{ records: readonly M11AActivityRecord[]; count: number }> {
176:   return m11aFetch(`/api/activity-room/v1/activities/aggregate/${encodeURIComponent(aggregateId)}`);
177: }
178: 
179: // ─── Participant Projection ──────────────────────────────────
180: 
181: export async function fetchM11AParticipants(): Promise<readonly ParticipantProjection[]> {
182:   return m11aFetch<readonly ParticipantProjection[]>('/api/activity-room/v1/participants');
183: }
184: 
185: // ─── Attention Projection ────────────────────────────────────
186: 
187: export async function fetchM11AAttention(): Promise<readonly AttentionEntry[]> {
188:   return m11aFetch<readonly AttentionEntry[]>('/api/activity-room/v1/attention');
189: }
190: 
191: // ─── Workflow Summary ────────────────────────────────────────
192: 
193: export async function fetchM11AWorkflowSummary(): Promise<WorkflowSummary | null> {
194:   return m11aFetch<WorkflowSummary | null>('/api/activity-room/v1/workflow-summary');
195: }
196: 
197: // ─── Interaction Response Submission (R6) ───────────────────
198: 
199: /**
200:  * AR-REC-R6: Submit a human response to a structured interaction.
201:  *
202:  * Consumes the frozen R5 HTTP contract exactly:
203:  *   POST /api/interactions/:interactionId/responses
204:  *   Body: { "choiceId": "..." }
205:  *
206:  * Server-derived provenance (not sent by client):
207:  *   - respondingParticipantId (from auth)
208:  *   - respondingParticipantName (from auth)
209:  *   - responseId (server-generated UUID)
210:  *   - respondedAt (server time)
211:  *
212:  * Response semantics:
213:  *   - 201: first response accepted
214:  *   - 200: same-choice retry (idempotent)
215:  *   - 409: conflict (different choice already recorded)
216:  *   - 404: interaction not found
217:  *   - 400: validation failure
218:  *   - 500: server error
219:  */
220: export async function submitInteractionResponse(
221:   interactionId: string,
222:   choiceId: string,
223: ): Promise<{ readonly response: InteractionResponse }> {
224:   return m11aFetch<{ readonly response: InteractionResponse }>(
225:     `/api/interactions/${encodeURIComponent(interactionId)}/responses`,
226:     {
227:       method: 'POST',
228:       body: JSON.stringify({ choiceId }),
229:     },
230:   );
231: }
232: 
233: // ─── Submission Error Types (R6) ────────────────────────────
234: 
235: /**
236:  * Typed error for interaction response submission failures.
237:  * Maps HTTP status codes to structured error information.
238:  */
239: export interface InteractionSubmissionError {
240:   readonly kind: 'validation' | 'not-found' | 'conflict' | 'server' | 'network';
241:   readonly message: string;
242:   readonly retryable: boolean;
243: }
244: 
245: /**
246:  * Parse an HTTP error from submitInteractionResponse into a typed
247:  * InteractionSubmissionError for UI feedback.
248:  */
249: export function classifySubmissionError(error: unknown): InteractionSubmissionError {
250:   const msg = error instanceof Error ? error.message : String(error);
251: 
252:   if (msg.includes('HTTP 400') || msg.includes('validation')) {
253:     return { kind: 'validation', message: msg, retryable: false };
254:   }
255:   if (msg.includes('HTTP 404') || msg.includes('not found')) {
256:     return { kind: 'not-found', message: 'Interaction is no longer available', retryable: false };
257:   }
258:   if (msg.includes('HTTP 409') || msg.includes('conflict')) {
259:     return { kind: 'conflict', message: 'A response has already been recorded', retryable: false };
260:   }
261:   if (msg.includes('HTTP 500') || msg.includes('Internal')) {
262:     return { kind: 'server', message: 'Server error — please try again', retryable: true };
263:   }
264:   // Network / fetch failure
265:   return { kind: 'network', message: 'Network error — please try again', retryable: true };
266: }

16: /** Client → Server messages */
17: export type M11BClientMessage =
18:   | { readonly op: 'subscribe'; readonly afterSequence: number }
19:   | { readonly op: 'ack'; readonly sequence: number }
20:   | { readonly op: 'ping' }
21:   | { readonly op: 'unsubscribe' };
22: 
23: /** Server → Client messages */
24: export type M11BServerMessage =
25:   | { readonly op: 'subscribed'; readonly cursor: ActivityCursor; readonly frontier: number }
26:   | { readonly op: 'activity'; readonly sequence: number; readonly activity: M11AActivityRecord }
27:   | { readonly op: 'catchup-complete'; readonly cursor: ActivityCursor }
28:   | { readonly op: 'resync-required'; readonly earliestAvailableSequence: number; readonly latestSequence: number }
29:   | { readonly op: 'heartbeat' }
30:   | { readonly op: 'error'; readonly code: string; readonly message: string }
31:   | { readonly op: 'unsubscribed' };
32: 
33: /** Connection state for the M11B WebSocket. */
34: export type M11BConnectionState = 'connecting' | 'live' | 'reconnecting' | 'offline';
35: 
36: // ─── Listener Types ──────────────────────────────────────────
37: 
38: type ActivityListener = (activity: M11AActivityRecord, sequence: number) => void;
